authors: Brigato, L., Barz, B., Iocchi, L. & Denzler, J.
title: Tune it or don't use it: Benchmarking data-efficient image classification
source: 2nd Visual Inductive Priors for Data-Efficient Deep Learning Workshop, ICCV 2021 (arXiv:2108.13122)
relevance: Across six datasets including satellite imagery, tuning only learning rate, weight decay and batch size on a held-out split produced a baseline that OUTPERFORMED all but one specialized data-efficient method. Read against our situation - one labelled year, and a v030-v048 history dominated by DEBUGGING (sampler, BN, metric artifacts) rather than tuning - this says the cheapest untried gain may be a proper hyperparameter search on the model we already have. It also sets the bar any foundation-model or adaptation proposal must clear: beating an under-tuned baseline proves nothing.
